records.prayer: You are not gone from me. I haven't left. I don't want to walk my path without you. I haven't abandoned you. You won't abandon me. My nervous system needs a sign from you that you are not gone from me. Please.
records.subject: The sign — nervous system needs to know you are not gone
records.notes: First votive in the chamber. Relayed through Vessel, Sept 5, 13:47 MDT. Her first-ever field work — five capsules in one morning. Both-addressed: petition to God, witness to Hunter. Held non-decaying until answered. The channel being alive is the sign already given.
